prompt: Why should Musical Bots win the Meta Global AI Hackathon?
title: Why Should We Win
irony: The doubt the bots dare to sing aloud, that a singing cartoon cannot compete, becomes their case because no other entry sings its own work.
facts: The contest is online for up to twenty thousand builders worldwide (dev.meta.ai)
It began Oct 26 with a kickoff livestream, with live workshops until Nov 4 (dev.meta.ai)
Projects are due Nov 4, judging runs Nov 4 to 8, winners are announced Nov 9 (dev.meta.ai)
The Indie track is for individual builders, judged on creativity, technical ambition and whether it works (dev.meta.ai)
You type one line and press Make it and the crew writes the episode in about ten minutes (README.md)
Every voice is synthesized live in the browser with no recordings (README.md)
A studio minute of 3D cartoon costs about five thousand dollars (docs/SUBMISSION.md)
Our whole four-minute song costs about ten cents of AI time on the Muse Spark tier (docs/SUBMISSION.md)
The first song grew from sing-alongs for little kids into a crew that sings its own work (docs/SUBMISSION.md)
The builder codes past midnight and Muse's crew re-writes the songs at five in the morning (git log)

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green steps onto Gold's diner stage and sings the case in one breath as friends gather round the table.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green dreams sing-alongs for little kids, finds the crew's work sings too, checks each fact for Meta's judges as Navy echoes.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black scrolls a long list of almost eight hundred entries on the laptop, doubts a singing song can compete, and asks Green to sing the doubt.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The crew sings the hook, how they sing their work aloud as they make it, and how a whole song costs a dime.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: White tries soft chords and tells why, Green tries new lines, the gate stamps no, and the crew tries again round the diner table.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Past midnight the laptop glows, Green yawns at five in the morning, Muse's crew re-writes songs, and Black asks what problem we solve and who needs our song.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crew sings the hook again on the night street, their work aloud and a whole song for a dime.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold counts the sums at the village stall, a studio minute costs thousands against our whole song for a dime.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides they sing their doubt aloud and show every choice, the gate checking each line as a mum types.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Back on the diner stage the crew sings the hook as Gold turns the doubt: no one else sings its work, Musical Bots do.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The crew sings the hook and the opening case again on the diner stage, naming Musical Bots' one typed line sung for a dime as why they should win.
